seo_description: AccesDirectAide accessibility statement: compliance status, contact and means of redress.
title: Accessibility statement
description: AccesDirectAide compliance status, contact and means of redress.
status: Accessibility: not compliant — no compliance audit has been carried out yet.
status_detail: No full RGAA (French accessibility standard) compliance audit has been carried out or scheduled to date: only automated checks and technical verifications are done during development. No compliance rate is therefore published. This page describes the known state of the service without claiming a compliance that has not been audited.
french_reference: This statement has been translated to help you read it. Only the French version is authoritative.
commitment.title: AccesDirectAide’s commitment
commitment.aim: AccesDirectAide aims to offer a service that as many people as possible can use, in particular with a keyboard, a screen reader, a high level of zoom and simplified content when needed.
commitment.standard: The working standard chosen is RGAA 4.1.2, consistent with the WCAG 2.1 level A and AA criteria covered by this standard.
compliance.title: Compliance status
compliance.text: AccesDirectAide is declared <0>not compliant</0> until a full and currently valid accessibility audit has made it possible to measure the compliance of the service.
checks.title: Checks carried out during development
checks.text: Automated checks and technical verifications are built into development. They do not replace a full RGAA audit or the necessary human checks, in particular with a keyboard and with assistive technologies.
checks.later: The detailed results, any non-compliance, exemptions and the audited sample will be published after a formal audit has been carried out.
technologies.title: Technologies used
falc.title: Easy to read and understand (FALC)
falc.text: The benefits planned for the launch have dedicated simplified content. FALC complements the reference information: it replaces neither the official source nor the applicable legal conditions.
contact.title: Feedback and contact
contact.text: If you cannot access some content or use a feature, you can report the problem so that an accessible solution or equivalent information can be sought.
recourse.title: Means of redress
recourse.text: If you notice an accessibility issue that prevents you from accessing content or a feature, you report it to us and you do not get a satisfactory answer, you can refer the matter to the Défenseur des droits (the French rights ombudsman).
improvement.title: Continuous improvement
improvement.text: The multi-year plan and the accessibility action plan will be published with verifiable commitments as soon as their scope has been formalised. This page will be updated after the audit and with each significant change.
